name: sync-sound
description: Migrador e sincronizador multi-streaming de playlists entre Spotify, Deezer e YouTube Music

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@syncsound/shared && npm run build --workspace=@syncsound/api && npm run build --workspace=@syncsound/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@syncsound/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@syncsound/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@syncsound/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@syncsound/shared && npm run test --workspace=@syncsound/api
